question.en: Discuss the challenges faced by Public Sector Banks in India and the measures taken by the government to address them.
question.hi: Discuss the challenges faced by Public Sector Banks in India and the measures taken by the government to address them.

structure.en: Introduction: Define PSBs and their role in the Indian economy.
structure.hi: Introduction: Define PSBs and their role in the Indian economy.

structure.en: Body: Challenges (NPAs, governance, political interference) and Measures (Indradhanush, consolidation, recapitalization, IBC).
structure.hi: Body: Challenges (NPAs, governance, political interference) and Measures (Indradhanush, consolidation, recapitalization, IBC).

structure.en: Conclusion: Way forward for a robust banking sector.
structure.hi: Conclusion: Way forward for a robust banking sector.

introduction.en: Public Sector Banks (PSBs) are the backbone of the Indian financial system, playing a crucial role in financial inclusion and credit delivery to priority sectors.
introduction.hi: Public Sector Banks (PSBs) are the backbone of the Indian financial system, playing a crucial role in financial inclusion and credit delivery to priority sectors.

body.en: Challenges include high levels of NPAs due to aggressive lending in the past, governance issues, and political interference. To address these, the government has implemented the Indradhanush plan, recapitalized banks to meet Basel III norms, consolidated smaller banks into larger entities, and introduced the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) for faster resolution of stressed assets.
body.hi: Challenges include high levels of NPAs due to aggressive lending in the past, governance issues, and political interference. To address these, the government has implemented the Indradhanush plan, recapitalized banks to meet Basel III norms, consolidated smaller banks into larger entities, and introduced the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) for faster resolution of stressed assets.

conclusion.en: While these reforms have improved the health of PSBs, further steps like professionalizing boards and reducing government stake are essential for long-term sustainability.
conclusion.hi: While these reforms have improved the health of PSBs, further steps like professionalizing boards and reducing government stake are essential for long-term sustainability.

valueAddition.en: The EASE (Enhanced Access and Service Excellence) index has been instrumental in tracking the performance of PSBs.
